name: file-tree
description: A live file tree beside the chat (/tree) that lights up the files Claude reads, edits and commits. Git status, line counts and find included.

autoOpen.title: Open the file tree
autoOpen.description: first-edit: once per session, when Claude first edits a file. never: only with /tree.

treeView.title: Tree shows
treeView.description: touched: only the files Claude has read or edited. all: every file. The t key switches between them.

icons.title: File icons
icons.description: auto: full-color picture icons where the terminal can draw them (Ghostty, kitty, iTerm2 3.5 or later, tmux with passthrough on), chips elsewhere. images: always try pictures, for ssh. chips: never use pictures.

glyphs.title: Terminal icons
glyphs.description: nerd: rounded chips and folder icons, needs a Nerd Font in your terminal. plain: standard Unicode only.
